title: μ-null sets of positive upper density are H^n-null (Ch. 1, 3.3 with outer regularity)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^N be open, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^N with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and Z ⊆ U with μ(Z) = 0 and limsup_{ρ↓0} μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n) > 0 for every x ∈ Z. Then H^n(Z) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U Z : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → Z ⊆ U → μ Z = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, 0 < limsup (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) → μHE[n] Z = 0
